root: ^These will probably be my last words. So for the next victim: if you got this far and haven’t got the metals, get them immediately. I did not and now I have to go back.

^If I didn’t have kids I would not care about getting out of here. Going back would mean packing up and running away for the rest of our lives. I know I stole food but I had no other choice to keep my family alive. And to accuse me of killing the Warlord? I didn’t even have a weapon.
^I have to go back. It will mean my death, but I have to try for my kids’ sake.
